Description: Size and eccentricity of the body in each scene. How the values were computed is not documented in this release. Their units are not documented either.

size_locs.Description: One row per image, in the order of stimulus_order.tsv. Column 1: body size, used as the predictor 'Body size' (BodySize). Column 2: body eccentricity, used as 'Body ecc.' (BodyEcc). Column 3: image number 1-120, equal to image_index + 1.
